title: Midpoint Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.29920v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Midpoint Generative Models (MGM), a principled framework for training one-step generative models. MGM is based on a simple symmetry of Flow Matching with linear interpolation: when the two endpoint distributions coincide, the corresponding velocity field vanishes at the midpoint time, $t=1/2$. We show that the norm of this field defines a valid discrepancy between distributions, which we call the Midpoint Divergence. We extend this discrepancy beyond the midpoint by introducing randomly flipped interpolations and further generalize it by replacing deterministic linear Flow Matching interpolations with symmetric stochastic interpolants, yielding a generalized Midpoint Divergence. Finally, we derive a variational formulation of our generalized divergence, yielding a tractable objective for training a one-step generator. translated_abstract: 我们提出了中点生成模型，这是一个用于训练单步生成模型的原理性框架。MGM基于线性插值流匹配的一个简单对称性：当两个端点分布重合时，相应的速度场在中点时刻 $t=1/2$ 处消失（即速度场为零）。我们证明该速度场的范数定义了一种有效的分布间差异度量，我们称之为中点散度。我们通过引入随机翻转的插值将该散度扩展到中点之外，并进一步通过用对称的随机插值替换确定性的线性流匹配插值对其进行推广，从而得到广义中点散度。最后，我们推导出该广义散度的变分形式，得到了一个可用于训练单步生成器的可处理优化目标。由此得到的MGM算法为生成建模提供了一种有效且具有理论基础的方法。
tldr: 本文利用线性插值流匹配在端点分布重合时速度场于中点时刻消失的对称性，提出中点散度及其广义变分形式，为训练单步生成模型提供了理论依据充分且可实现的优化目标。
en_tdlr: By exploiting the symmetry that the velocity field of linear-interpolation Flow Matching vanishes at the midpoint time when the two endpoint distributions coincide, this paper introduces the Midpoint Divergence and its generalized variational formulation, providing a theoretically grounded and tractable objective for training one-step generative models.
